english.title: Distributor of electrical equipment not in conformity with regs fail to take corrective measures
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an distributor of electrical equipment who considered or had reason to believe that electrical equipment namely **(..SPECIFY EQUIPMENT..), you had made available on the market, was not in conformity with Part 2, failed to immediately take necessary corrective measures to

(A)_[bring that electrical equipment into conformity]_
(B)_[withdraw that electrical equipment]_
(C)_[recall that electrical equipment]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 29(1), 50(1) and 51(1) of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
